source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of Sana'ani-inspired Jabal tower-house silk brocade edged with oxidized Yemeni silver hirz filigree: crisp chalk-white carved-gypsum juss chevron lattices (#eae5da) framing four jewel-toned qamariya stained-glass floral rosettes across in dragon-crimson (#8a1619), Bowl-emerald (#1b6b46), amber-gold (#d19a26), and midnight indigo (#141e3c), bordered along top and bottom by hammered oxidized sterling-silver (#bfc4c9) talismanic cartouche trim inlaid with carnelian and turquoise, seam-safe. Full colour.
